brainlife.desc: MEG/EEG source estimate (MNE STC): left and right hemisphere .stc files of source time courses on the cortical surface.
brainlife.name: neuro/meeg/stc
brainlife.readme:
**Use for:** Extracting label time courses or morphing to fsaverage for group analysis.

**Not for:** Volume source estimates; only surface STC pairs are supported. Group comparison before morphing to a common brain (fsaverage tag).

**BIDS:** no BIDS counterpart.

**Sharing:** Tier 2 (pseudonymised participant-level) by default.

**Apps:** Input to 2 Apps, output of 3 Apps.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.meeg.stc.json

identifying_risks: Vertex layout follows the individual cortical surface unless morphed.
governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 6: participant-level functional derivative linkable through a participant code.
tier_conditions: Tier 4 if used to decode or profile individual cognitive states.
